easyPrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact creature.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any nontoken artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creaitng a Munitions token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Munitions token, adding {C}{C}.
The Munitions tokens triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
